focused_pytest.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -o addopts='' -q tests/test_runner_native_cluster.py tests/test_runner_shutdown.py tests/visualization/test_runtime.py tests/visualization/test_modal_app.py

flake8.scope: changed runner/native cluster tests, project CI ignore list, max line length 120

black.scope: runner and native cluster tests; line length 120

frontend.command: npm run check && npm run build

git_diff_check.scope: Authored source/docs only; excludes verbatim raw evidence

raw_diff_whitespace.note: Full staged diff reports upstream COLMAP trailing spaces and literal log/patch whitespace. Raw bytes are intentionally preserved and hashes verified; authored source/docs pass.

provenance: Coordinator-observed final checks before GPU freeze; recorded after source hash confirmation. Full CPU subprocess evidence is independent final-cpu-1/processes.json. No historical prototype tests are counted.
